top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a complete, original and independently confirmed arc from the physiology of GLP-1 as a glucose-dependent incretin (Holst), through identification of its active GLP-1(7-36) form (Mojsov), to receptor and gut-hormone biology and the therapeutic concept (Drucker), validated by mature randomized outcome evidence in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The three-person allocation fits the limit and the citation stays within the discoveries; no award is clearly inferior given this maturity and impact.
